shortDescription.default: Let site admins post targeted notifications across modern SharePoint pages.

longDescription.default: Site administrators can use a notification list to post notifications, warnings, and errors without editing individual pages. Target a site and optionally its subsites, schedule messages, and choose modal and dismissal settings. An administration web part provides guided setup, status checks, and previews; an application customizer displays eligible messages on supported modern pages. Visitors need read access to the list.
